customSections.label: What the 173, 180 and 201 Totals Mean
customSections.content: The totals at the bottom of the HCS calendar count different things. The four quarter totals add to 180 days, but that number includes seven professional development days when students are out. HCS separately shows 173 student dates, three of which are half-days. The 201 total also includes staff in-service days, paid holidays and paid Winter Break.

calendarFaqs.q: Is the Hamilton County Schools 2027–28 calendar approved?
calendarFaqs.a: The official HCS calendar page labels both the English and Spanish calendars approved April 16, 2026. The reviewed English filename still contains Draft and the PDF itself does not print an approval line, so this page records both facts.

calendarFaqs.q: Why are students out on April 17, 2028?
calendarFaqs.a: Good Friday is April 14, and the HCS calendar marks Monday, April 17 as a professional development day. Students return Tuesday, April 18, creating a four-day student weekend.

calendarFaqs.q: Does the HCS calendar show 180 full student days?
calendarFaqs.a: No. The quarter rows total 180 days by combining 173 green student dates with seven blue professional development days. Three green student dates are labeled as half-days, so 180 is not a count of full-length student attendance days.

calendarFaqs.q: What time do students leave on HCS half-days?
calendarFaqs.a: HCS marks December 17, March 10 and May 25 as half-days with early bus release, but the district calendar does not publish one districtwide dismissal time. Check your school's schedule for the exact pickup and transportation time.

sourceReviewSummary: We used the English HCS calendar for dates and color classifications, and the official HCS calendar page to verify its approved status, Spanish edition and current source links.
sourceReviewDetails: Reviewed the complete one-page PDF, its color legend, all month grids, half-day markings, quarter rows, midterms, report-card dates and printed totals.
Confirmed that the HCS calendar page labels both 2027–28 editions Approved 4/16/26.
Recorded that the reviewed English file is still named 2027-2028 School Calendar (Draft).pdf and does not print a board-approval line inside the document.
Used the blue professional development cells to determine that students return October 19, November 30, January 5, March 21 and April 18 after the four major breaks and Good Friday weekend.
Kept the printed 173, 180 and 201 totals separate because they represent different calendar accounting views.
School-specific activities, conference times, exact half-day dismissal times and later schedule changes should be confirmed through HCS or the assigned school.
